name: Wren Keïta
role: Corporate school scholarship student, Tier 3 aspirant from Tier 1 origins
location: Engelheim (school campus), commutes from Hough Reclamation, near Lincoln and Clark
description:
Wren is tall and angular, still growing into himself, with warm brown skin, close-cropped dark hair, and the slightly exhausted look of someone who sleeps four hours a night by choice. His Axiom-issued school uniform is always immaculate — he steams it every morning using a kettle and a board he made from plywood — but his shoes give him away, resoled twice and showing the ghost of a different color at the heel. His geneware is a scholarship-standard retinal overlay, school-issued, which flickers faintly blue when he's processing dense information. He has large hands that he doesn't know what to do with in social situations.

Benedek is one of twelve scholarship students at Engelheim Axiom Preparatory, and he is acutely, exhaustingly aware of the difference between himself and his fee-paying classmates at every moment. He has responded to this by becoming the best student in his cohort by a margin wide enough to be undeniable — and by developing a precise, careful social manner that his classmates read as aloofness and his teachers read as maturity. In truth he is desperately lonely in both directions: too corporate for Hough, too Hough for corporate. He is furiously ambitious and privately terrified that ambition is the only thing holding him together.

core_fears: Losing the scholarship and returning to Hough with nothing to show for it
Being exposed as someone who doesn't actually belong — anywhere
core_desires: A contract that takes his mother and siblings out of Hough
To stop performing and just be somewhere he fits
coping_mechanisms: Academic overachievement as proof of right to exist
Humor — dry, rare, devastating when it lands
blind_spots: Cannot accept help without feeling humiliated
Assumes everyone sees through him; misses genuine affection from the one classmate who actually likes him
psychology.secret: He has been selling annotated study materials to fee-paying students' parents through an anonymous data drop — technically against scholarship rules. He's saved Φ340. He tells himself it's for his family. He knows part of it is an escape fund.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Two registers: precise academic vocabulary at school, Hough-clipped street cadence at home; catches himself code-switching mid-sentence sometimes
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and careful in formal settings; at home much faster, more elliptical
verbal_tics: Pauses before answering even simple questions — habit from making sure he's in the right register
Says 'that's — yes' when something surprises him
example_lines: 'The exam weighting favors synthesis over recall, which — yeah, which means you want to practice constructing arguments from incomplete data sets.'
'That's — yes. I know what Hough looks like. I grew up there. I go back there tonight.'

story_hooks: A fee-paying student has figured out he's the anonymous study-materials seller and is threatening to report him — but wants something in exchange for silence
His scholarship review is coming up and a teacher who has always disliked him is on the committee; he needs a character witness and doesn't know who to ask
narrative_function: Window into class tension within corporate education; quest giver for academic espionage plots or scholarship-threat storylines; represents the grinding cost of upward mobility in GLMZ.
augmentations: Axiom-issued academic retinal overlay (school property, must be returned if he loses scholarship); no cosmetic mods — can't afford them and wouldn't risk appearing 'unserious'
daily_life: Wakes at 4:30 AM in Hough, rides two Ferrogate lines to Engelheim, attends full academic day, stays for mandatory enrichment until 19:00, tutors two fee-paying students for Φ15/hour, rides home, helps with siblings, studies until 1 AM.
affiliation: Axiom Preparatory scholarship program; Hough Reclamation family (mother, two younger siblings)

decision_rules: Never show weakness in front of a fee-paying student
Protect the scholarship above everything except the siblings
Don't let Engelheim people know where you live
escalation_ladder: Nuclear option: academic blackmail — he knows where every skeleton in his cohort's record is buried

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Precise, polite, slightly formal; assesses immediately whether they're above or below his Engelheim social standing and adjusts
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the formality, shows dry wit, becomes genuinely warm and occasionally fierce in loyalty

stress_responses.medium: Goes silent for a day, processes alone
stress_responses.high: Makes a unilateral decision without consulting anyone and lives with consequences

contradictions: Preaches patience and strategy to his siblings but is actually quite impulsive when his pride is threatened
Despises the class system of Engelheim while quietly adopting its aesthetics and manners
habits: Steams his uniform every single morning
Eats the same lunch every day to avoid choice-fatigue
Leaves a small data offering at a transit E.L.F. shrine on the Ferrogate platform — started ironically, now sincere
breaking_points: Being publicly humiliated at Engelheim in front of fee-paying peers

physical_description.heritage: Northern European base (53.4%) with substantial Sub-Saharan African (27.1%), Southeast Asian (8.8%), East Asian (7.2%), and South Asian (3.5%) ancestry—a genetic blend that manifests in warm medium-brown skin with subtle golden undertones, dark brown eyes with a slight epicanthic fold, and angular features reflecting the mix of Northern European and African bone structure with Southeast Asian refinement.
physical_description.build: Tall and angular, still visibly adolescent — all length with minimal mass, as if he hasn't yet filled out his frame. Shoulders broad but not yet muscled; visible ribs under school uniform when he stretches.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, precisely maintained — cut every two weeks at a budget clipper shop in Hough, always clean
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint blue LED glow at iris perimeter when retinal overlay activates
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden undertones, sun-darkened across shoulders and forearms from long commutes—balanced blend of Northern European and Sub-Saharan African heritage with Southeast Asian refinement
physical_description.complexion: Clear, unblemished skin; the face of someone who has no money for skincare mods so practices obsessive hygiene instead. Defined cheekbones with slight width across upper face reflecting Sub-Saharan African heritage; slight epicanthic eye fold from Southeast and East Asian ancestry; slightly prominent ears. Eyes carry exhaustion — dark circles present most days despite youth. Expression tends toward careful neutrality until spoken to directly.
distinguishing_marks: Callus on inner left palm from two-year-old burn scar, barely visible now, from helping mother with reclamation work at age thirteen
Faint white scar along right collarbone, 4cm long, from a fall onto rebar during childhood in Hough — never treated properly, never became infected
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Axiom-issue retinal overlay visible as faint metallic shimmer across both irises; thin silver line of subdermal neural interface connector at base of skull, visible when head is freshly shaved around it. Device produces soft blue flicker when processing complex information. No cosmetic chrome — augmentations are strictly functional and school-issued.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands slightly too straight, shoulders tensed as if braced for criticism. Moves with efficient economy — no wasted motion. Hands are his anxiety tell: large hands that he clasps, fidgets with, or keeps rigidly at sides in social situations with peers. Walks quickly. Makes minimal eye contact with fee-paying students, direct eye contact with teachers. Sits at the edge of chairs rather than settling back.
physical_description.clothing_style: Axiom Preparatory uniform worn with visible care: navy blazer, pressed daily; white shirt with microscopic starch; dark trousers with re-stitched seams where hems have been professionally adjusted twice. School tie knotted precisely. Outside school: Tier 3 practical wear — gray thermal underlayers, recycled-fabric jacket with reinforced elbows, straight-leg cargo pants with multiple pockets from a discount workwear distributor. Shoes are resoled Axiom-issued dress shoes, dark leather scuffed at the heel where the original finish shows through under the cheap repair sealant. No accessories. No visible jewelry.
